description:
Ask the SAT about up to 25 invoices in one call — same service and same answer per invoice as `cfdi_status`, with the SAT's request for restraint built in: **at most 2 requests in flight**, duplicates asked once, answers remembered in memory for 10 minutes (an outage is never remembered), and once 2 consecutive requests have failed no new one is started (one already in flight still finishes). Use it to reconcile a handful of invoices; it is not a bulk-verification pipeline, and the SAT states its service is sized for up to 2 million queries per hour and asks callers not to raise their volume.

Each item is either `{ xml }` (preferred — the four values are derived from it) or `{ rfc_emisor, rfc_receptor, total, uuid }`. An item that cannot be queried (bad XML, unstamped, malformed field) is reported on its own line with the reason and costs no request; it does not fail the batch.

Per item, `outcome` is: `queried` (asked the SAT now), `cached` (answered from memory, up to 10 minutes old), `duplicate` (same invoice as an earlier item), `rejected` (never sent; see `error`) or `skipped` (not attempted after repeated outages). A `queried` item whose `result.available` is false means the SAT did not answer — a statement about the SAT, never about the invoice. The same applies to `skipped`.

Args:
  - items (array of 1-25): each with `xml` OR rfc_emisor + rfc_receptor + total + uuid.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): output format (default 'markdown').

Returns: { total, queried, cached, duplicates, rejected, skipped, unavailable, stopped_after_outage, items[{index, outcome, source, error, uuid, result}] }, where `result` has the shape `cfdi_status` returns (without `source`).

Example: "Are these three invoices still live?" -> cfdi_batch_status(items=[{xml:"…"},{xml:"…"},{xml:"…"}]).

rfc_emisor.description: Issuer's RFC. Required unless `xml` is given.

rfc_receptor.description: Receiver's RFC. Required unless `xml` is given.

total.description: Total exactly as written in the XML, e.g. '1160.00'. Required unless `xml` is given.

uuid.description: The UUID of the Timbre Fiscal Digital. Required unless `xml` is given.

xml.description: The complete CFDI XML. When given, the four fields are derived from it.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary (default) or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: cfdi_batch_status
title: CFDI Status at the SAT, several invoices
